independence: Independent of runtime-helper author; this agent authored only the phosphate pair and resource scientific reviews.
source_state: working_tree plus external prepared helper files
scope: Twelve specified runtime helpers and helper-lineage.json; exact hashes below. Read-only static assessment and AST parsing; no helper execution or publication.

findings.title: Hosted receipt repeats previous-cohort authorship and round label
findings.description: The future round97 receipt says root authored bassanite and reviewed wood ash, which belong to the preceding cohort. Its Markdown heading remains Round96. A copied helper should not emit false authorship for the present six-record cohort.
findings.acceptance: Replace authorship with accurate round97 operational scope and fix the heading; retain actual role limits and hash the corrected helper.

findings.title: Mutating helpers do not reject occupied dangling receipt paths before acting
findings.description: These four helpers guard output only with not Path.exists(), then perform push/PR creation, queue admission, branch deletion or main fast-forward and write receipts with write_text. A dangling symlink is an occupied path for which exists() is false, so the promised early no-overwrite/refuse-existing-path behavior is bypassed; write_text follows it. A bounded synthetic test reproduced those Path semantics without running any helper or external mutation. Existing regular receipts are rejected; no exploit or actual corruption is claimed.
findings.acceptance: Before any mutation reject exists() OR is_symlink(); use exclusive receipt creation so a collision introduced later cannot overwrite a receipt. Apply consistently to maintained receipt writers and add a targeted harmless guard regression check.

findings.title: Publish does not bind current external PR metadata to prepared/committed bytes
findings.description: Commit records a helper-config hash in its bindings, but publish loads the current config title without comparing that hash and first reads PR body only after pushing. Its post-create comparison confirms agreement with the current body, not the prepared/reviewed body. Thus changing config title or body after preparation can publish changed metadata with an unchanged reviewed Git HEAD. This is a static stale-input gap, not a claim that the current draft metadata has changed.
findings.acceptance: Bind the reviewed body and config hashes in an immutable preparation/commit or dedicated publication handoff, validate those bindings and exact branch/base/head/tree before the first remote mutation, and use the bound bytes for creation. Recheck body/config bindings before queue admission.

evidence.scope: Static reading and AST parsing only; no runtime helper or Git/GitHub mutation executed. Receipt guard test used only fresh temporary synthetic files, then cleaned that temporary directory.

positive_assessments: All twelve files parse as Python. All ten lineage source and target hashes match, and the claimed lower-case round/base substitutions reproduce each target exactly. That verifies lineage, not semantic fitness of carried-forward prose.
Commit checks actual record/history/review hashes, base/head, untracked-path allowlist, explicit staged paths and current main; no existing owner/history/review replacement is admitted.

Enqueue requires preflight base/head/tree, mandatory successful commands, exact PR file set/current required check and an immediately preceding live-main observation. Native queue and postmerge checks remain necessary because this is not atomic locking.
Cleanup verifies exact merged tree and sole parent, then removes only the owned remote ref using a lease and the owned local branch; retains a clean detached worktree.
Main sync checks original hidden/ignored files, modes and symlinks, preserved review tag and durable backup, incoming/nontracked path conflicts, then uses ff-only without autostash.
Fresh-clone pre/post verification rejects occupied paths including symlinks and checks retained tags, absent topic object, exact tree/parent, native record/history/review gates and coverage.
Hosted audit uses GET operations and current attempt-specific job lists, checks all five roles, exact identities/blobs, closing observations and immutable hash checks.
Configured null pending counts are a deliberate incomplete handoff; no runtime approval or successful execution is inferred.
limitations: No PR, merge, hosted run, issue state or runtime receipt was accepted by this static review. Fresh gate, preparation, peer, commit, preflight, queue and postmerge receipts remain mandatory.
No full test suite rerun. A local synthetic receipt-path experiment tested only pathlib semantics; actual helpers were not imported or run.
The helper-lineage document is an accurate snapshot of initial copied bytes; subsequent fixes require explicit new current-hash provenance rather than silently claiming substitution-only lineage.

Archive is scope-limited to selected listed helpers; it does not currently copy final-gates, preservation-check, review-check-final or its own helper source. Their current hashes are recorded in this review.
